verdict.summary: The round-1 major finding is resolved. The revised text explicitly limits raw-handle publication to the catalog/enrollment path, names the generated enrollment surfaces that intentionally expose handles, and narrows the fingerprint invariant to the operational lease, health, dashboard, and identity-diagnostic surfaces. Those statements match the checked implementation: lease identities are full-matched as 16 lowercase hex; model-health requires handle plus salt and validates assembled/read records; dashboard observability rejects non-fingerprint labels and scans the finished document for catalog identities; and the diagnostic workflows hash identity-bearing values or withhold them when salt is absent. The prose also expressly disclaims the unsupported repo-wide no-generated-handle invariant identified in round 1. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in this documentation-only diff.
